sections.description: Portable ACF blocks, header utilities, and directory content types for custom WordPress sites.
sections.changelog:
1.10.1

  • Fixed a fatal error on the front-end Block Lab index and block scenario pages by registering the CSS layer declaration through WordPress's stylesheet API.

1.10.0

  • Theme-aware responsive defaults for all sixteen blocks, with easy theme overrides.
  • Preserved block-specific styles in the frontend and editor.
  • Split Block Lab into an index and dedicated block pages, expanded its variations, and added automated PHP/browser regression coverage.
